minutes.headline: Conservation Commission continued most hearings to Feb 7 and extended the Brockelman Pond permit three years with a narrative requested.
minutes.summary: The Commission met by Zoom with the chair absent, so a commissioner presided. Nearly every hearing was continued to February 7 because applicants were absent or awaiting DEP file numbers. Members also approved timber harvesting on the town's land, extended an aquatic-vegetation permit, authorized the vice chair to consult town counsel on 390 Howard Street, and heard an update on the Google Drive to SharePoint move.

what_happened.line: The Conservation Commission voted to extend the Brockelman Pond order of conditions three years and asked for a narrative on past treatments and future plans.
The Commission continued the hearings for 390 Howard Street, 255 Sunny Hill Road, 171 Arbor Street and three 20 Kilburn Street filings to February 7.
Members approved timber harvesting on the raino property and authorized the chair or vice chair to sign the contract.
Members gave the vice chair permission to discuss 390 Howard Street with Town Counsel; the chair's vote was not clearly audible.
Documents will stay on Google Drive through the next meeting while the move to SharePoint is worked out.

why_it_matters: Wetland permits for house lots and pond management wait on this board, so continued hearings push back when neighbors and applicants get decisions.
The 390 Howard Street consultation with Town Counsel and the culvert matter at 780 Northfield Road were carried forward, so both remain open items for residents nearby.
